problem: Transfer actionable manipulation guidance from human RGBD video to a robot without matching robot-action labels.
contribution: General Flow predicts language-conditioned3Dquery-point trajectories, serving as an embodiment-independent post-grasp affordance consumed by a geometric robot controller.
algorithm: Extract3Dflow labels from HOI4D geometry or tracked RGBD human-object points. A CLIP-conditioned PointNeXt/cVAE predicts normalized relative point trajectories and scale, with trajectory/scale/KL/accumulation losses. Use predicted near-gripper point flow and SVD/ICP alignment for closed-loop robot transforms.
observations: Calibrated RGBD scene point clouds, text, query points and robot segmentation; the demonstrated D455/Franka system has metric depth, unlike a plain RGB overview camera.
actions: Predicted3Dpoint flow is not a joint command. A heuristic geometric/impedance controller converts it into end-effector motion after manual task/grasp initialization.
embodiment_and_data: Human RGBD/HOI4D supervision; real Franka tests cover18tasks across6scenes. Training/test flow split80/10/10has no identical object instances; most robot-test categories/tasks were seen in training, and ToyCar/Safe instances are not novel.
experiments: Flow ADE/FDE prediction and separate real post-grasp tasks,10trials each. Assays articulated/rigid/soft objects, segmentation, grasp manner and direction. Manual initial positioning is explicitly required.
baselines: ResNet/R3M/ViT, VAT-MART, PointNeXt and ScaleFlow sizes for prediction; physical downstream comparisons have their own setup. Prediction centimeters do not imply robot task completion.

quantitative_result.value: Physical post-grasp Table2 totals146/180=81%(rounded), but drawer open-grasp3/10 and open-pull4/10 expose failures. These are manually initialized post-grasp trials, not autonomous end-to-end acquisition. ScaleFlow-L test ADE3.55cm/FDE4.70cm is a separate prediction metric.

limitations: Limited data diversity/cVAE capacity, manual grasping and an ICP heuristic constrain contact-rich tasks. RGBD calibration and object segmentation are prerequisites. Claimed broad representation support does not demonstrate arbitrary unseen categories or fully autonomous grasp acquisition.
code_and_license: Paper lists multiple inherited codebases; independent code/data/dependency-license audit and local execution were not performed. Do not assume one paper-level license covers every component.
hardware_adaptation: Compare object-relative guidance as context after establishing metric depth/frames and target controller validity. It cannot be reproduced from uncalibrated RGB plus guessed force. Keep manual initialization and partial pipeline scope visible in evaluation.
